definition: A simplified computation worksheet for calculating the qualified business income deduction available to individual taxpayers and certain trusts and estates with qualified business income, qualified REIT dividends, or qualified PTP income below specified taxable income thresholds.

includes.text: Computation of qualified business income deduction with income and loss entries
includes.quote: Qualified Business Income Deduction Simplified Computation

includes.text: Determination of qualified trades or businesses and qualified business income items
includes.quote: Determining Your Qualified Trades or Businesses

includes.text: Tracking of suspended losses and deductions by code section and year
Calculation of deduction limited to percentage of taxable income
includes.quote: Taxable income limitation adjustments. Taxable income

excludes.text: Detailed phase-in calculations for specified service trades or businesses above threshold
Aggregation elections combining multiple trades or businesses
Wage and property basis limitation computations

discriminators.text: Computes deduction from business income and REIT/PTP income; does not itemize personal deductions or report charitable contributions, medical expenses, or other itemized deduction categories
discriminators.quote: Qualified Business Income Deduction Simplified Computation

discriminators.text: Reports qualified business income from multiple potential sources including pass-through entities and REIT dividends; does not report gross receipts, cost of goods sold, or business expenses in detail

Applies to trades or businesses including farming but also partnerships, S corporations, and service businesses; does not limit to agricultural operations or report farm-specific items like crop sales or livestock
discriminators.quote: Your qualified trades and businesses include your domestic trades or businesses
